key: JULIA: This place smells terribadtastic!
en: JULIA: This place smells terribadtastic!
ja: ジュリア: ここ、最悪でひどい匂いがする!

key: FLORINIA: The observed wine hue is indicative of exorbitant levels of pollutants.
en: FLORINIA: The observed wine hue is indicative of exorbitant levels of pollutants.
ja: フロリニア: 観測されたワイン色は、汚染物質が過剰な水準にあることを示している。

key: Estimated toxicity: 90+%.
en: Estimated toxicity: 90+%.
ja: 推定毒性: 90パーセント以上。

key: FERN: So they're polluting the lake as well as committing arson.
en: FERN: So they're polluting the lake as well as committing arson.
ja: ファーン: つまり放火だけじゃなく、湖の汚染までやってるってわけか。

key: Either way, they're still the bad guys.
en: Either way, they're still the bad guys.
ja: どっちにしろ、こいつらが悪者なのは変わらねえ。

key: We gonna do something about it, or are we just gonna stand here snivelling?
en: We gonna do something about it, or are we just gonna stand here snivelling?
ja: 何か手を打つのか、それともメソメソ突っ立ってるだけか?

key: FLORINIA: Rather than a source of active pollution, this facility appears to be collecting data on the water, and--
en: FLORINIA: Rather than a source of active pollution, this facility appears to be collecting data on the water, and--
ja: フロリニア: この施設は、能動的な汚染源というよりも、水に関するデータを収集しているようで、それから――

key: JULIA: Waitwaitwait, where'd all the teenywords go?!
en: JULIA: Waitwaitwait, where'd all the teenywords go?!
ja: ジュリア: ちょっとちょっと、小さい言葉たちどこ行っちゃったの!?

key: FLORINIA: Data purge suspected.
en: FLORINIA: Data purge suspected.
ja: フロリニア: データ消去が行われた疑いがある。

key: Hypothesis: Facility operatives have begun procedural deactivation of non-critical systems to avoid divulging gathered data and information.
en: Hypothesis: Facility operatives have begun procedural deactivation of non-critical systems to avoid divulging gathered data and information.
ja: 仮説: 施設の運用者が、収集済みのデータや情報の漏えいを避けるため、非重要系統の手続き的な停止を開始した。

key: FERN: Then let's stop twiddling our thumbs and get moving already.
en: FERN: Then let's stop twiddling our thumbs and get moving already.
ja: ファーン: だったら、ぼさっとしてねえでさっさと動くぞ。

key: We don't exactly have the privilege of stealth after a certain someone announced our presence by blowing up the entire front door.
en: We don't exactly have the privilege of stealth after a certain someone announced our presence by blowing up the entire front door.
ja: どこかの誰かさんが正面のドアを丸ごと吹っ飛ばして存在をアピールしちまった以上、隠密行動なんてぜいたくは言ってられねえしな。

key: JULIA: What, am I just supposed to NOT blow things up?!
en: JULIA: What, am I just supposed to NOT blow things up?!
ja: ジュリア: え、アタシに爆破すんなって言うわけ!?

key: Don't be ridiculous!
en: Don't be ridiculous!
ja: ばかばかしい!

key: FLORINIA: The path diverges ahead.
en: FLORINIA: The path diverges ahead.
ja: フロリニア: この先で道が分岐している。

key: The most efficient course of motion through the facility for thorough investigation and reclamation of the property necessitates a similar bisection of the party.
en: The most efficient course of motion through the facility for thorough investigation and reclamation of the property necessitates a similar bisection of the party.
ja: この施設を徹底的に調査し、財産を回収するための最も効率的な行動経路は、パーティを同様に二分することを必要とする。

key: FERN: Could you try speaking English for once?
en: FERN: Could you try speaking English for once?
ja: ファーン: たまには普通の言葉で話してくれねえか?

key: JULIA: She said we should split up.
en: JULIA: She said we should split up.
ja: ジュリア: 分かれた方がいいって言ってるの。

key: Duhhhh.
en: Duhhhh.
ja: あったりまえでしょ。

key: Rini will come with me! We'll take the side route!
en: Rini will come with me! We'll take the side route!
ja: リニはアタシと一緒! こっちは横のルートね!

key: \PN, you go with Fern.
en: \PN, you go with Fern.
ja: \PNは、ファーンと一緒に行って。

key: Try not to let his attitude get to you~
en: Try not to let his attitude get to you~
ja: こいつの態度に振り回されないようにね~

key: FERN: Excuse me?
en: FERN: Excuse me?
ja: ファーン: あ?

key: JULIA: Nothing!
en: JULIA: Nothing!
ja: ジュリア: なんでもなーい!

key: Come on, Rini, let's goooooo!
en: Come on, Rini, let's goooooo!
ja: さあ、リニ、行こーう!

key: FLORINIA: Proceed with caution.
en: FLORINIA: Proceed with caution.
ja: フロリニア: 注意しつつ進行せよ。

key: FERN: I always do, Sis.
en: FERN: I always do, Sis.
ja: ファーン: いつもそうしてるさ、姉貴。

key: FLORINIA: You were not the intended recipient of my previous statement.
en: FLORINIA: You were not the intended recipient of my previous statement.
ja: フロリニア: 先の発言の対象は、お前ではない。

key: Permission for you to be life-endangeringly reckless: Granted.
en: Permission for you to be life-endangeringly reckless: Granted.
ja: 命を危険にさらすほどの無謀な行動を取る許可を、お前に与える。

key: FERN: As you can see, she didn't get enough hugs growing up. Not my problem.
en: FERN: As you can see, she didn't get enough hugs growing up. Not my problem.
ja: ファーン: 見ての通り、こいつは育ちの中で抱っこが足りなかったんだよ。オレの知ったこっちゃねえけどな。

key: Well, \PN, looks like it's you and me after all.
en: Well, \PN, looks like it's you and me after all.
ja: さて、\PN、結局お前とオレってわけだ。

key: Come on, smile!
en: Come on, smile!
ja: ほら、笑えよ!

key: You're lucky you have me to carry you.
en: You're lucky you have me to carry you.
ja: オレに運んでもらえるんだから、ラッキーだと思えよ。

key: Just try not to slow me down, got it?
en: Just try not to slow me down, got it?
ja: オレの足を引っ張るなよ、いいな?

key: FERN: If you're done goofing off, let's get going.
en: FERN: If you're done goofing off, let's get going.
ja: ファーン: ふざけてねえで、さっさと行くぞ。

key: You're in for a world of pain!
en: You're in for a world of pain!
ja: 地獄のような痛みを味わわせてやる!

key: Ow...
en: Ow...
ja: 痛って……

key: Tch, we did our job.
en: Tch, we did our job.
ja: チッ、仕事はやったぜ。

key: Our orders are clear. Bring out your Pokémon.
en: Our orders are clear. Bring out your Pokémon.
ja: 命令ははっきりしている。ポケモンを出せ。

key: Huh... We got exterminated.
en: Huh... We got exterminated.
ja: は……全滅させられちまった。

key: You will fail.
en: You will fail.
ja: お前は失敗する。

key: You have NO idea what you're getting into.
en: You have NO idea what you're getting into.
ja: 自分が何に足を踏み入れてるのか、まるで分かってねえな。

key: Don't say I didn't warn you~
en: Don't say I didn't warn you~
ja: 忠告しなかったなんて言わせないから~

key: The boss doesn't play so nice.
en: The boss doesn't play so nice.
ja: ボスはそんなに甘くないわよ。

key: You know you really shouldn't have come here.
en: You know you really shouldn't have come here.
ja: ここに来るべきじゃなかったのに。

key: You really don't know what you're doing, do you?
en: You really don't know what you're doing, do you?
ja: 自分が何やってるか、本当に分かってないんだな?

key: Fools.
en: Fools.
ja: 愚か者め。

key: Intruders? In OUR base?
en: Intruders? In OUR base?
ja: 侵入者だと? このオレたちのアジトに?

key: It's more likely than we think.
en: It's more likely than we think.
ja: 思ったよりありそうな話だな。

key: Oh, well. We did what we had to.
en: Oh, well. We did what we had to.
ja: ま、いいさ。やるべきことはやったんだ。

key: Stop right there!
en: Stop right there!
ja: そこで止まれ!

key: Or don't.
en: Or don't.
ja: それか、止まらないか。

key: Not my problem if you get decked.
en: Not my problem if you get decked.
ja: ぶっ倒されても知ったこっちゃないわ。

key: Just turn around right now and nobody will get hurt.
en: Just turn around right now and nobody will get hurt.
ja: 今すぐ引き返せば、誰も傷つかずに済む。

key: So I was the one who got hurt. Hmph.
en: So I was the one who got hurt. Hmph.
ja: 結局傷ついたのはオレか。フン。

key: Defeat aside, we did enough.
en: Defeat aside, we did enough.
ja: 負けはしたが、やるべきことはやった。

key: You shall not pass!
en: You shall not pass!
ja: 通すわけにはいかん!

key: Ugh, fine.
en: Ugh, fine.
ja: うぐ、分かったよ。

key: Pass. If you must.
en: Pass. If you must.
ja: 通れ。仕方ないならな。

key: We have a goal to achieve. You won't get in our way!
en: We have a goal to achieve. You won't get in our way!
ja: 我々には成し遂げるべき目標がある。邪魔はさせん!

key: Ugh. This just sets me back again.
en: Ugh. This just sets me back again.
ja: うっ。またこれで後戻りだ。

key: Every failure makes it a little longer until...
en: Every failure makes it a little longer until...
ja: 失敗を重ねるたび、少しずつ遠のいていく……

key: What are you doing here?
en: What are you doing here?
ja: こんなところで何をしている?

key: Ohhh, so that's what you're doing.
en: Ohhh, so that's what you're doing.
ja: ああ、そういうことしてるんだ。

key: Hm... Something's weird, right?
en: Hm... Something's weird, right?
ja: ん……何か変よね?

key: You want the goods? Come and get them.
en: You want the goods? Come and get them.
ja: ブツが欲しいのか? 取りに来い。

key: Ugh...
en: Ugh...
ja: うっ……

key: The boss won't be happy.
en: The boss won't be happy.
ja: ボスは喜ばないだろうな。

key: Just what do you want with our bombs?
en: Just what do you want with our bombs?
ja: オレたちの爆弾に、一体何の用だ?

key: ...Oh shit.
en: ...Oh shit.
ja: ……くそ。

key: You're going to kill us all, aren't you.
en: You're going to kill us all, aren't you.
ja: オレたち全員、殺す気だろ。

key: Get out of my sight.
en: Get out of my sight.
ja: 目の前から消えろ。

key: Go.
en: Go.
ja: 行け。

key: I said get out!
en: I said get out!
ja: 出てけって言ってんだよ!

key: Intruders? What would you need here?
en: Intruders? What would you need here?
ja: 侵入者? ここに何の用だ?

key: Tsk. Get out of our faces.
en: Tsk. Get out of our faces.
ja: チッ。オレたちの前から消えろ。

key: You're on thin ice, you know?
en: You're on thin ice, you know?
ja: 危ない橋渡ってるって分かってんのか?

key: Got you!
en: Got you!
ja: 捕まえたぞ!

key: I got nothin'.
en: I got nothin'.
ja: オレは何も持ってねえよ。

key: Get outta here.
en: Get outta here.
ja: 消えろ。

key: Team Meteor will prevail!
en: Team Meteor will prevail!
ja: チームメテオは必ず勝つ!

key: Even if we lose here, Team Meteor will still rise above.
en: Even if we lose here, Team Meteor will still rise above.
ja: ここで負けても、チームメテオは必ず上に立つ。

key: You should stop getting in our way while we're still feeling merciful.
en: You should stop getting in our way while we're still feeling merciful.
ja: こっちがまだ慈悲を感じてるうちに、邪魔するのをやめておけ。

key: Don't take another step.
en: Don't take another step.
ja: それ以上近づくな。

key: Hmph. They've had enough time anyway.
en: Hmph. They've had enough time anyway.
ja: フン。どうせ十分時間はあったんだしな。

key: You're toast if the boss gets you.
en: You're toast if the boss gets you.
ja: ボスに見つかったら、お前終わりだぞ。

key: I spy with my little eye... intruders!
en: I spy with my little eye... intruders!
ja: あたしの小さな目が見つけちゃった……侵入者!

key: Well, well, you can go on right ahead!
en: Well, well, you can go on right ahead!
ja: あらあら、どうぞそのまま進んでいいわよ!

key: What are you waiting for, hm?
en: What are you waiting for, hm?
ja: 何を待ってるの、ん?

key: The door has been sealed shut from inside.
en: The door has been sealed shut from inside.
ja: 扉は内側から封鎖されている。

key: The door is locked shut.
en: The door is locked shut.
ja: 扉には鍵がかかっている。

key: The exit is sealed shut.
en: The exit is sealed shut.
ja: 出口は封鎖されている。

key: FERN: Just where do you think you're going?
en: FERN: Just where do you think you're going?
ja: ファーン: どこ行くつもりだよ?

key: I told you not to slow me down.
en: I told you not to slow me down.
ja: 足引っ張るなって言ったろ。

key: But if you've gotta go do something, go right ahead! I'll just wait here.
en: But if you've gotta go do something, go right ahead! I'll just wait here.
ja: でも何かやることがあるなら、行ってこいよ! ここで待ってるからよ。

key: ???: So, the esteemed guests of honor have arrived!
en: ???: So, the esteemed guests of honor have arrived!
ja: ???: おやおや、ご立派な貴賓の皆様がお越しとはね!

key: ???: I know they say you should knock before you enter, but I don't think they quite meant for you to knock the entire door in!
en: ???: I know they say you should knock before you enter, but I don't think they quite meant for you to knock the entire door in!
ja: ???: 入る前にノックするものだとは言うけれど、ドアを丸ごとぶっ壊せとは、誰も言っていないと思うんだけどねぇ!

key: Kind of you to announce your calling though--
en: Kind of you to announce your calling though--
ja: まあ、来訪を知らせてくれるとは親切だこと――

key: Not that it was entirely necessary when we already got a tip that the police had found just this place--
en: Not that it was entirely necessary when we already got a tip that the police had found just this place--
ja: もっとも、警察がこの場所を見つけたって情報は、すでにこちらに入ってたから、必要とまでは言えないけどね――

key: But kind nonetheless!
en: But kind nonetheless!
ja: それでも親切なことに変わりはないさ!

key: Gives us ample time to drop a few bippity-bop-bop-bop buttons aaaand...
en: Gives us ample time to drop a few bippity-bop-bop-bop buttons aaaand...
ja: おかげで、ちょいちょいっとボタンを押す時間もたっぷりできたし……

key: Boop!
en: Boop!
ja: ポチッと!

key: ???: Data was released to the wild.
en: ???: Data was released to the wild.
ja: ???: データは野に放たれた。

key: Bye-bye data!
en: Bye-bye data!
ja: ばいばい、データ!

key: The name's Ace, by the way!
en: The name's Ace, by the way!
ja: ちなみに、名前はエースというのだよ!

key: First rate agent, statistician, systemic admin, master magician--
en: First rate agent, statistician, systemic admin, master magician--
ja: 一流のエージェント、統計士、システム管理者、そして手品の達人――

key: And professional dead end to meandering little vagrants like yourselves!
en: And professional dead end to meandering little vagrants like yourselves!
ja: そして、君たちのような迷える放浪者にとっては、プロの行き止まりというわけさ!

key: In the first place, you should know that I'm more steamed than a sauna that we have to go around dumping all this carefully-collected information!
en: In the first place, you should know that I'm more steamed than a sauna that we have to go around dumping all this carefully-collected information!
ja: そもそも、せっかく丹念に集めた情報を、こうして捨てて回らなきゃならないなんて、私はサウナよりも熱くなっているのだよ!

key: I mean, sure, it'll be on the network.
en: I mean, sure, it'll be on the network.
ja: まあ、確かに、ネットワークには残るがね。

key: Who doesn't use cloud storage these days?
en: Who doesn't use cloud storage these days?
ja: 今どき、クラウドストレージを使わない者などいるかね?

key: But still, it FEELS bad!
en: But still, it FEELS bad!
ja: それでも、気分が悪いのだよ!

key: How could you do this to me?
en: How could you do this to me?
ja: よくもこんな真似をしてくれたものだ。

key: And there's so much to go through and delete!
en: And there's so much to go through and delete!
ja: それに、確認して削除しなきゃならないものが、これだけ大量にあるとはね!

key: These file transfers say it's two hours remaining!
en: These file transfers say it's two hours remaining!
ja: このファイル転送、残り2時間だと言っている!

key: Wait, two minutes!
en: Wait, two minutes!
ja: いや、2分だ!

key: Nope, three hours!
en: Nope, three hours!
ja: いやいや、3時間だ!

key: Who knows how long it'll take?
en: Who knows how long it'll take?
ja: どれだけかかるか、誰にも分からんね。

key: So if you could just stay there in place, stand right there--
en: So if you could just stay there in place, stand right there--
ja: だから、そこにじっと立っていてくれると、

key: Yes, just like that, silly expression and all-- for just some time more...
en: Yes, just like that, silly expression and all-- for just some time more...
ja: そう、その滑稽な表情のままで――もう少しの間だけ……

key: We'd be much obliged.
en: We'd be much obliged.
ja: 大いに助かるのだがね。

key: I suspect you won't, though.
en: I suspect you won't, though.
ja: まあ、そうはしてくれなさそうだが。

key: Grunts!
en: Grunts!
ja: 下っ端たちよ!

key: What an unfortunate name, by the way.
en: What an unfortunate name, by the way.
ja: それにしても、ふびんな呼び名だな。

key: Isn't that disrespectful?
en: Isn't that disrespectful?
ja: 失礼だと思わないかね?

key: But if you wanted to be called something else, you should've been better. Anyway--
en: But if you wanted to be called something else, you should've been better. Anyway--
ja: だが、別の呼び方をされたければ、もっと精進すべきだったな。とにかく――

key: Little grunts, please slow our guests down!
en: Little grunts, please slow our guests down!
ja: 小さな下っ端たちよ、お客人を足止めしてくれたまえ!

key: Buy me enough time and I'll buy your wages another day!
en: Buy me enough time and I'll buy your wages another day!
ja: 十分な時間を稼いでくれれば、いつか給料を弾んでやろう!

key: FERN: What the hell is their problem?
en: FERN: What the hell is their problem?
ja: ファーン: こいつら一体何なんだよ?

key: I was expecting some kind of sinister team; not a spring-picked fruits basket.
en: I was expecting some kind of sinister team; not a spring-picked fruits basket.
ja: もっと不気味な集団を期待してたのに、まるで摘みたての果物カゴだな。

key: Let's just get up there and wipe that stupid smile off their face.
en: Let's just get up there and wipe that stupid smile off their face.
ja: さっさと上に行って、あのバカ面をぶっ飛ばしてやるぞ。

key: FERN: Hey, what gives?
en: FERN: Hey, what gives?
ja: ファーン: おい、何のつもりだ?

key: ACE: Sorry, little wannabes!
en: ACE: Sorry, little wannabes!
ja: エース: すまないね、小さな志望者たちよ!

key: I'm afraid the power's been cut on your little hit-and- rescue operation!
en: I'm afraid the power's been cut on your little hit-and- rescue operation!
ja: 君たちの小さな救出作戦、電源が切れてしまったようでね!

key: The 'trapped-in-a-box' trick gets them every time!
en: The 'trapped-in-a-box' trick gets them every time!
ja: 「箱に閉じ込める」トリックは、いつだって効果てきめんなんだよ!

key: Be good little fledglings and stay put there until the show is over and we've dealt with your Gym Leader friends, will you?
en: Be good little fledglings and stay put there until the show is over and we've dealt with your Gym Leader friends, will you?
ja: いい子のひな鳥たちらしく、ショーが終わって、ジムリーダーの友人たちの相手が済むまで、そこでじっとしていてくれたまえ。

key: FERN: Like hell we will!
en: FERN: Like hell we will!
ja: ファーン: そんなわけあるかよ!

key: ACE: Oh-- well, that's awkward, because, you see--
en: ACE: Oh-- well, that's awkward, because, you see--
ja: エース: ああ――それは困ったな、なぜなら、ね――

key: You don't actually have a choice in the matter?
en: You don't actually have a choice in the matter?
ja: 君たちに、その選択肢はないのだよ?

key: It was one of those rhetorical questions, you know?
en: It was one of those rhetorical questions, you know?
ja: あれは、修辞疑問というやつだったんだがね?

key: Don't worry, little one. You'll figure those out eventually.
en: Don't worry, little one. You'll figure those out eventually.
ja: 心配しなくていい、小さな子よ。そのうち分かるようになるさ。

key: Why don't you think on it while you're trapped there?
en: Why don't you think on it while you're trapped there?
ja: そこに閉じ込められている間、考えてみるといい。

key: Actually, better idea!
en: Actually, better idea!
ja: いや、もっといい考えがある!

key: You two are obviously strapping young lads with a sense of justice and urgency.
en: You two are obviously strapping young lads with a sense of justice and urgency.
ja: 君たち二人は、正義感と切迫感にあふれた、たくましい若者に見えるな。

key: You two are obviously strapping young Trainers with a sense of justice and urgency.
en: You two are obviously strapping young Trainers with a sense of justice and urgency.
ja: 君たち二人は、正義感と切迫感にあふれた、たくましいトレーナーに見えるな。

key: I know you just got here and this offer usually comes closer to the climax, but let's just get it out of the way now!
en: I know you just got here and this offer usually comes closer to the climax, but let's just get it out of the way now!
ja: 来たばかりで、普通この手の誘いはクライマックスの近くでするものだが、今のうちに済ませてしまおう!

key: Would you consider joining us?
en: Would you consider joining us?
ja: 我々に加わることを、考えてみないかね?

key: Our methods might not be popular-- and that's kind of the point, you know?
en: Our methods might not be popular-- and that's kind of the point, you know?
ja: 我々のやり方は人気があるとは言えないが――まあ、それこそが要点なのだよ?

key: But I promise you this, little heroes, we're the ones looking out for this region.
en: But I promise you this, little heroes, we're the ones looking out for this region.
ja: だが約束しよう、小さな英雄たちよ、この地方を見守っているのは我々なのだ。

key: We come with great insurance and a family plan!
en: We come with great insurance and a family plan!
ja: 立派な保険と、家族向けプランもついてくるぞ!

key: Give it a think, yeah?
en: Give it a think, yeah?
ja: 考えてみたまえ、な?

key: FERN: Let us out of here and I'll tell you exactly what I think!
en: FERN: Let us out of here and I'll tell you exactly what I think!
ja: ファーン: ここから出してくれたら、何を考えてるか正確に教えてやるよ!

key: ACE: Mmmmmmmm...
en: ACE: Mmmmmmmm...
ja: エース: ふぅーむ……

key: Nope!
en: Nope!
ja: 却下だ!

key: I'll come back and check on you once we're all cleaned up though, so until then, just stew on it!
en: I'll come back and check on you once we're all cleaned up though, so until then, just stew on it!
ja: 片付いたら様子を見に戻ってくるから、それまでじっくり考えているといい!

key: FERN: Ugh, there's Julia--
en: FERN: Ugh, there's Julia--
ja: ファーン: うぇ、ジュリアがいるぞ――

key: GRUNT: Agent, the front wing has been destroyed!
en: GRUNT: Agent, the front wing has been destroyed!
ja: 下っ端: エージェント、正面の翼棟が破壊されました!

key: The Gym Leaders are coming up!
en: The Gym Leaders are coming up!
ja: ジムリーダーたちが上がってきています!

key: ACE: Tch, just when we'd gotten a break.
en: ACE: Tch, just when we'd gotten a break.
ja: エース: チッ、せっかく一息つけたところなのにな。

key: I suppose I'll deal with this myself!
en: I suppose I'll deal with this myself!
ja: どうやら自分で対処するしかなさそうだ!

key: Hang tight, you two!
en: Hang tight, you two!
ja: そこでじっとしていたまえ、二人とも!

key: FLORINIA: Primary security overridden.
en: FLORINIA: Primary security overridden.
ja: フロリニア: 一次セキュリティ、突破完了。

key: Elevator power restored.
en: Elevator power restored.
ja: エレベーターの電源、復旧完了。

key: ACE: Uh, no you just did not! That's MY security station, woman!
en: ACE: Uh, no you just did not! That's MY security station, woman!
ja: エース: いや、まさか、やってないよな!? そこは私のセキュリティステーションだぞ、女!

key: Drat!
en: Drat!
ja: くそっ!

key: FERN: I guess Flobot can be good for something occasionally.
en: FERN: I guess Flobot can be good for something occasionally.
ja: ファーン: フロボットも、たまには役に立つこともあるってわけか。

key: Let's hustle, \PN.
en: Let's hustle, \PN.
ja: 急ぐぞ、\PN。

key: "ELEVATOR LOCK"
en: "ELEVATOR LOCK"
ja: 「エレベーターロック」

key: The console displays a numerical keypad.
en: The console displays a numerical keypad.
ja: コンソールには、数字のキーパッドが表示されている。

key: The door unlocked!
en: The door unlocked!
ja: ドアの鍵が開いた!

key: Nothing happened...
en: Nothing happened...
ja: 何も起こらなかった……

key: FERN: Figures they're going to have some kind of pathetic security.
en: FERN: Figures they're going to have some kind of pathetic security.
ja: ファーン: 案の定、しょぼいセキュリティだな。

key: Let's look around the lower floor.
en: Let's look around the lower floor.
ja: 下の階を見て回ろうぜ。

key: Bet there are other greenlit consoles we can try and scrounge some data from before they toss it.
en: Bet there are other greenlit consoles we can try and scrounge some data from before they toss it.
ja: 他にも緑色に光ってるコンソールがあるだろうし、あいつらが捨てちまう前にデータをかき集めてやろうぜ。

key: The screen lights up...
en: The screen lights up...
ja: 画面が光った……

key: "3XXX"
en: "3XXX"
ja: 「3XXX」

key: "X1XX"
en: "X1XX"
ja: 「X1XX」

key: "XXX9"
en: "XXX9"
ja: 「XXX9」

key: FERN: Looks like there's only two floors.
en: FERN: Looks like there's only two floors.
ja: ファーン: どうやら2階しかないみたいだな。

key: Hit it, \PN.
en: Hit it, \PN.
ja: 押せよ、\PN。

key: Ground Floor-- Now arrived.
en: Ground Floor-- Now arrived.
ja: 1階――到着しました。

key: FERN: That's the floor we're already on, numbnuts.
en: FERN: That's the floor we're already on, numbnuts.
ja: ファーン: それ、もう今いる階だろ、間抜けが。

key: Can't you even figure that out?
en: Can't you even figure that out?
ja: それすら分からねえのか?

key: 2F-- Now arrived.
en: 2F-- Now arrived.
ja: 2階――到着しました。

key: FERN: You know we're already on the second floor, right?
en: FERN: You know we're already on the second floor, right?
ja: ファーン: もう2階にいるって分かってるよな?

key: Like, did you ever learn how floors work?
en: Like, did you ever learn how floors work?
ja: つーか、階数の仕組みくらい習っただろ?

key: Or numbers?
en: Or numbers?
ja: 数字とかもな?

key: Counting?
en: Counting?
ja: 数を数えるとか?

key: Maybe you've heard of it?
en: Maybe you've heard of it?
ja: 聞いたことくらいあるだろ?

key: FERN: What, now you're not going to actually hit the button?
en: FERN: What, now you're not going to actually hit the button?
ja: ファーン: は、今度はボタン押さねえのかよ?

key: Are you deliberately messing with me, or are you just on their side now?
en: Are you deliberately messing with me, or are you just on their side now?
ja: わざとオレをからかってんのか、それともあいつらの味方になったのか?

key: Stop messing around and hit it already.
en: Stop messing around and hit it already.
ja: ふざけてないで、さっさと押せよ。

key: FERN: Come ON already, \PN.
en: FERN: Come ON already, \PN.
ja: ファーン: いい加減にしろよ、\PN。

key: There's no time for this.
en: There's no time for this.
ja: こんなことしてる時間ねえんだよ。

key: FLORINIA: A brute-force hacking program has been deployed to the system and is currently attempting to bypass secondary security.
en: FLORINIA: A brute-force hacking program has been deployed to the system and is currently attempting to bypass secondary security.
ja: フロリニア: ブルートフォース攻撃プログラムをシステムに展開した。現在、二次セキュリティの突破を試行中である。

key: Meanwhile, this speaker is analyzing the remaining data on the system interface.
en: Meanwhile, this speaker is analyzing the remaining data on the system interface.
ja: その間、この発話者はシステムインターフェース上の残存データを解析している。

key: Most data has been deleted, and more still is being cleared by the moment.
en: Most data has been deleted, and more still is being cleared by the moment.
ja: 大半のデータはすでに削除されており、今この瞬間にも削除が続いている。

key: This "Ace" operative is likely still working from an additional terminal within the central station to which they have fled.
en: This "Ace" operative is likely still working from an additional terminal within the central station to which they have fled.
ja: この「エース」なる工作員は、逃げ込んだ中央ステーション内の別端末から、依然として作業を続けている可能性が高い。

key: This speaker will report anything of note that is found.
en: This speaker will report anything of note that is found.
ja: 特筆すべきものが見つかり次第、この発話者が報告する。

key: For instance, an additional security password hint was discovered:
en: For instance, an additional security password hint was discovered:
ja: 例えば、追加のセキュリティパスワードのヒントが発見された:

key: "XX6X"
en: "XX6X"
ja: 「XX6X」

key: FLORINIA: Secondary security failure observed.
en: FLORINIA: Secondary security failure observed.
ja: フロリニア: 二次セキュリティの機能停止を確認。

key: FERN: If by 'failure' you mean we unlocked it, sure.
en: FERN: If by 'failure' you mean we unlocked it, sure.
ja: ファーン: その「機能停止」ってのが、解除したって意味なら、そうだな。

key: FLORINIA: Affirmative.
en: FLORINIA: Affirmative.
ja: フロリニア: 肯定。

key: Secondary firewall has been disabled.
en: Secondary firewall has been disabled.
ja: 二次ファイアウォールは無効化された。

key: Obtaining access.
en: Obtaining access.
ja: アクセス取得中。

key: Access granted.
en: Access granted.
ja: アクセス許可。

key: Let us proceed.
en: Let us proceed.
ja: 進行しよう。

key: JULIA: Wait, what do you mean access granted?!
en: JULIA: Wait, what do you mean access granted?!
ja: ジュリア: ちょっと、アクセス許可ってどういうこと!?

key: But we were gonna--
en: But we were gonna--
ja: だってアタシたち、これから――

key: The boomies!
en: The boomies!
ja: ドッカーンするはずだったのに!

key: What happened to the boomies!?
en: What happened to the boomies!?
ja: ドッカーンはどこ行ったの!?

key: Majestic explosions, heart-racing destruction...
en: Majestic explosions, heart-racing destruction...
ja: 荘厳な爆発、胸を高鳴らせる破壊……

key: You can't just do this to me, Rini!
en: You can't just do this to me, Rini!
ja: こんなのアリじゃないよ、リニ!

key: Rini!!!
en: Rini!!!
ja: リニ!!!

key: Come back here!
en: Come back here!
ja: 戻ってきて!

key: FERN: Hah, leave it to my sister to ruin everyone's fun.
en: FERN: Hah, leave it to my sister to ruin everyone's fun.
ja: ファーン: はっ、うちの姉貴に任せりゃ、みんなの楽しみは台無しになるってもんだ。

key: Whatever, let's get a move on it.
en: Whatever, let's get a move on it.
ja: ま、いいから動くぞ。

key: JULIA: Rini said there's a storage room on the north side, so that's probably where they're keeping the bombs!
en: JULIA: Rini said there's a storage room on the north side, so that's probably where they're keeping the bombs!
ja: ジュリア: リニが、北側に倉庫があるって言ってたから、たぶんそこに爆弾があるんだよ!

key: Get in there, grab them, get out, and we'll get blastin'!
en: Get in there, grab them, get out, and we'll get blastin'!
ja: 中に入って、取って、出てくれば、あとはドッカーンだね!

key: I'd do it myself, buuuuuut I'm tired.
en: I'd do it myself, buuuuuut I'm tired.
ja: アタシが自分でやってもいいんだけど、疲れちゃってさ。

key: And someone's gotta watch Rini's back while she's doing whatever it is she's doing in their system!
en: And someone's gotta watch Rini's back while she's doing whatever it is she's doing in their system!
ja: それに、リニがシステムでなんかやってる間、誰かが見張ってなきゃだしね!

key: Also I'm tired.
en: Also I'm tired.
ja: あと疲れてるし。

key: Do you think they have a bed I can borrow?
en: Do you think they have a bed I can borrow?
ja: ここ、借りられるベッドとかあるかな?

key: FERN: Hey, crazy lady. We got your goods.
en: FERN: Hey, crazy lady. We got your goods.
ja: ファーン: おい、イカれた姉ちゃん。ブツ持ってきたぞ。

key: JULIA: Boomies!
en: JULIA: Boomies!
ja: ジュリア: ドッカーン!

key: Beautiful, bombastic boomies!
en: Beautiful, bombastic boomies!
ja: 美しくて、けたたましいドッカーン!

key: Ooo, Verdignite!
en: Ooo, Verdignite!
ja: おお、ヴァーディグナイトだ!

key: This stuff is fun.
en: This stuff is fun.
ja: こいつは楽しいやつだよ。

key: FERN: What, you know the specific type of explosive?
en: FERN: What, you know the specific type of explosive?
ja: ファーン: は、爆発物の種類まで分かんのかよ?

key: JULIA: Uhhhhhhh, obviously!
en: JULIA: Uhhhhhhh, obviously!
ja: ジュリア: えー、当然でしょ!

key: It's named for its green color, but it's unique cuz the internal chemicals react as they oxidize!
en: It's named for its green color, but it's unique cuz the internal chemicals react as they oxidize!
ja: 緑色にちなんでその名前がついてるんだけど、内部の化学物質が酸化と共に反応するのが特徴なんだよ!

key: In other words, all you gotta do to make it shake its stuff is break open the plastic casing!
en: In other words, all you gotta do to make it shake its stuff is break open the plastic casing!
ja: つまり、暴れさせたいなら、プラスチックのケースを割るだけでいいってこと!

key: FERN: Glad I didn't drop it on the way over here...
en: FERN: Glad I didn't drop it on the way over here...
ja: ファーン: ここまで来る途中で落とさなくてよかったぜ……

key: JULIA: Okay, let's do this!
en: JULIA: Okay, let's do this!
ja: ジュリア: よし、やるよ!

key: JULIA: Okay!
en: JULIA: Okay!
ja: ジュリア: よーし!

key: JULIA: Three...
en: JULIA: Three...
ja: ジュリア: さーん……

key: Two...
en: Two...
ja: にー……

key: Kaaaaaaa...
en: Kaaaaaaa...
ja: カアアアア……

key: ...Huh?
en: ...Huh?

key: FLORINIA: Secondary firewall overridden in line with secondary security failure.
en: FLORINIA: Secondary firewall overridden in line with secondary security failure.
ja: フロリニア: 二次セキュリティの機能停止に伴い、二次ファイアウォールを突破済み。

key: JULIA: But the--
en: JULIA: But the--
ja: ジュリア: でも、その――

key: JULIA: ...Well, okay.
en: JULIA: ...Well, okay.
ja: ジュリア: ……まあ、いっか。

key: Not that there was nothing to even blow up anymore, buuuuuut I'll take it!
en: Not that there was nothing to even blow up anymore, buuuuuut I'll take it!
ja: 別にもう爆破するものがなくなっちゃったわけじゃないけど、まあこれでいいや!

key: FLORINIA: Your penchant for wanton destruction remains decidedly superfluous.
en: FLORINIA: Your penchant for wanton destruction remains decidedly superfluous.
ja: フロリニア: 無軌道な破壊への志向は、明らかに不要である。

key: JULIA: You're right, it IS super!
en: JULIA: You're right, it IS super!
ja: ジュリア: そうだよね、超いいよね!

key: And now we charge ever-forward!
en: And now we charge ever-forward!
ja: さあ、どんどん前に突き進むぞ!

key: Goooooo team!
en: Goooooo team!
ja: チーム、いけーっ!

key: JULIA: ...But like, our team. Not Team Meteor.
en: JULIA: ...But like, our team. Not Team Meteor.
ja: ジュリア: ……あ、アタシたちのチームね。チームメテオじゃなくて。
……行けーっ!!!

key: FLORINIA: ...Indeed.
en: FLORINIA: ...Indeed.
ja: フロリニア: ……その通りだ。

key: FERN: Pretty sure Julia should've been arrested a long time ago.
en: FERN: Pretty sure Julia should've been arrested a long time ago.
ja: ファーン: ジュリアなんて、とっくの昔に逮捕されてるべきだと思うぜ。

key: ACE: Double drat!
en: ACE: Double drat!
ja: エース: これはまいったな!

key: One, I could take.
en: One, I could take.
ja: 一人なら、相手できる。

key: Two's a fair bout.
en: Two's a fair bout.
ja: 二人でも、いい勝負だ。

key: But three's a whole crowd~
en: But three's a whole crowd~
ja: だが、三人となると大群だな~

key: And four is right out!
en: And four is right out!
ja: 四人なんて、話にならん!

key: Consider this a tactical, if temporary, retreat!
en: Consider this a tactical, if temporary, retreat!
ja: これは戦術的――一時的とはいえ――撤退と考えてくれたまえ!

key: The commander will have orders, I'm sure.
en: The commander will have orders, I'm sure.
ja: 司令官から、指示があるはずだ。

key: TTFTT--
en: TTFTT--
ja: それでは――

key: Ta-ta for the time!
en: Ta-ta for the time!
ja: しばしの、さらばだ!

key: Please feel free to show yourselves out at your own leisure!
en: Please feel free to show yourselves out at your own leisure!
ja: どうぞご自由に、ごゆっくりお帰りくだされ!

key: JULIA: Hey, get back here so I can blow your face off!!!
en: JULIA: Hey, get back here so I can blow your face off!!!
ja: ジュリア: ちょっと、戻ってきなさいよ、顔面ドッカーンしてあげるから!!!

key: FERN: Hah! What a coward.
en: FERN: Hah! What a coward.
ja: ファーン: はっ! 臆病者め。

key: FLORINIA: Meteor Headquarters confirmed beyond gate.
en: FLORINIA: Meteor Headquarters confirmed beyond gate.
ja: フロリニア: メテオ本部が、この門の先にあることを確認した。

key: JULIA: So then it's just a matter of opening it!
en: JULIA: So then it's just a matter of opening it!
ja: ジュリア: それじゃ、あとは開けるだけだね!

key: I'm sure Electrode could blow this up too, but I'm starting to run out of Revives here...
en: I'm sure Electrode could blow this up too, but I'm starting to run out of Revives here...
ja: マルマインなら吹っ飛ばせると思うんだけど、そろそろ「げんきのかけら」が切れそうでさ……

key: FLORINIA: This facility's digital security system appears substandard.
en: FLORINIA: This facility's digital security system appears substandard.
ja: フロリニア: この施設のデジタルセキュリティシステムは、水準以下と見受けられる。

key: The primary firewall has been accessed. Only a secondary one remains.
en: The primary firewall has been accessed. Only a secondary one remains.
ja: 一次ファイアウォールへのアクセスは完了した。残るは二次のみである。

key: A brute force attack should be sufficient. Please hold.
en: A brute force attack should be sufficient. Please hold.
ja: ブルートフォース攻撃で十分だろう。しばし待たれよ。

key: JULIA: Brute force? Rini, I don't think we're gonna be able to punch through the door!
en: JULIA: Brute force? Rini, I don't think we're gonna be able to punch through the door!
ja: ジュリア: ブルートフォース? リニ、それドア殴っても開かないと思うよ!

key: Buuuuuut, they were responsible for blowing up the station and they were planning to hit my Gym too, right?
en: Buuuuuut, they were responsible for blowing up the station and they were planning to hit my Gym too, right?
ja: でもさ、あいつら駅を爆破した犯人で、アタシのジムも狙ってたんだよね?

key: I bet they'd let us borrow their boomies if we asked really nicely!
en: I bet they'd let us borrow their boomies if we asked really nicely!
ja: すごく丁寧にお願いすれば、ドッカーンを貸してくれるんじゃない!

key: And maybe punched them in the face!
en: And maybe punched them in the face!
ja: あと、顔面パンチもね!

key: And then asked nicely again!
en: And then asked nicely again!
ja: それからもう一回丁寧にお願いする!

key: If we can get those, I can get us past here no problem-o!
en: If we can get those, I can get us past here no problem-o!
ja: それさえ手に入れば、ここを通るのなんて楽勝だよ!

key: \PN, think you can find where they keep the explosives?
en: \PN, think you can find where they keep the explosives?
ja: \PN、爆発物がどこにあるか、見つけられそう?

key: FLORINIA: A facility map indicates a storage room behind a security lock on the north side of the premises.
en: FLORINIA: A facility map indicates a storage room behind a security lock on the north side of the premises.
ja: フロリニア: 施設の地図によれば、敷地北側の防犯ロックの先に倉庫がある。

key: JULIA: There, I bet that's where they are!
en: JULIA: There, I bet that's where they are!
ja: ジュリア: ほら、絶対そこにあるって!

key: If you can do that, we'll be in easily!
en: If you can do that, we'll be in easily!
ja: それを持ってきてくれたら、簡単に入れるようになるから!

key: FLORINIA: Why is combustion your solution to every obstacle?
en: FLORINIA: Why is combustion your solution to every obstacle?
ja: フロリニア: なぜお前は、あらゆる障害への解決策が燃焼なのだ?

key: JULIA: Cuz it's fun for the whole family!
en: JULIA: Cuz it's fun for the whole family!
ja: ジュリア: だって家族みんなで楽しめるからだよ!

key: FERN: Tch, whatever.
en: FERN: Tch, whatever.
ja: ファーン: チッ、まあいいわ。

key: I, for one, don't care to stand around all day while Flobot plays with computers.
en: I, for one, don't care to stand around all day while Flobot plays with computers.
ja: 少なくともオレは、フロボットがコンピューターで遊んでる間、一日中突っ立ってるつもりはねえからな。

key: JULIA: That's the spirit!
en: JULIA: That's the spirit!
ja: ジュリア: その意気だよ!

key: For once Fern says something I agree with!
en: For once Fern says something I agree with!
ja: ファーンの言うことに賛成するの、珍しいな!

key: Quick, \PN! To the boom-mobile!
en: Quick, \PN! To the boom-mobile!
ja: 急いで、\PN! ドッカーンモービルへ!

key: "Future Project Notes--
en: "Future Project Notes--
ja: 「未来計画メモ――

key: P-06-- Limitless Amplification
en: P-06-- Limitless Amplification
ja: P-06――無限増幅

key: P-07-- Seamless Transportation
en: P-07-- Seamless Transportation
ja: P-07――シームレス転送

key: P-08-- Perfect Control"
en: P-08-- Perfect Control"
ja: P-08――完全制御」

key: The rest seems to have been deleted...
en: The rest seems to have been deleted...
ja: 残りは削除されてしまったようだ……

key: FERN: I don't like the sound of any of this.
en: FERN: I don't like the sound of any of this.
ja: ファーン: どれも聞くだけで嫌な予感がするな。

key: Let's put a muzzle on these guys before they ever get a chance to make any of this happen.
en: Let's put a muzzle on these guys before they ever get a chance to make any of this happen.
